title: MSFS 2024 Marketplace Breakdown: Boeing 707 Revamp, FSReborn Sirius & 11 new add-ons!
description:
Are you looking to invest in your Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 hangar this week, or are you trying to navigate past the storefront landmines? Today, we are breaking down a massive wave of recent Marketplace releases spanning everything from light sport tourers and quadjet classics to specialized medevac conversions, helicopter releases, and high-visibility livery suites.

In this deep-dive marketplace breakdown, we arrange all 11 new arrivals into four dedicated categories to evaluate system depth, flight model promises, custom EFB features, and visual fidelity to see which add-ons genuinely deserve a spot on your virtual ramp:

✈️ PRIMARY AIRCRAFT RELEASES
We kick off with FSReborn's high-wing carbon composite TL Ultralight Sirius TL-3000, packed with native MSFS CFD prop physics, custom carburetor modeling, opening doors, and an interactive maintenance tablet. Next, we inspect the fully revamped Boeing 707-320C by Microsoft & Working Title—bringing classic Cold War quadjet airline ops, analog steam gauges, passenger/cargo convertible flexibility, and Career Mode KD compatibility. We also look at the beginner-friendly CRJ-NG series from Virtualcol/VS Software (with important notes on non-study-level fidelity) and Dream Scenery's sleek RZC Challenger 370 executive concept jet.

🚑 MISSION & AIRFRAME EXPANSIONS
For utility and humanitarian simmers, SimWorks Studios (SWS) delivers the Kodiak 100 Medevac Expansion, adding dedicated air ambulance interior layouts and four specialized medical liveries (note: requires base SWS Kodiak 100 ownership).

🚁 FLIGHT DECK & SOUND ENHANCEMENTS
Heavy-lift rotary fans can now pick up the Airbus Helicopters H225 as a standalone addition across multiple configurations, while Tu-Pilot brings a custom Black & Red interior restyle package for the Daher TBM 930 cockpit.

🎨 DEDICATED PAINT & LIVERY SUITES
Finally, we highlight targeted livery packs, including a 13-livery commercial/cargo suite for the Flysimware Learjet 35A and three massive livery expansions for the AzurePoly/JFXP Dassault Rafale C—featuring Special Anniversaries (Normandie-Niemen, Lorraine), Airshow Displays, and NATO Tiger Meet schemes.

Which of these add-ons are you loading onto your virtual ramp first? Hand-flying the Sirius TL-3000, managing classic steam gauges in the Boeing 707, or running air ambulance sorties in the Kodiak? Let us know in the comments below!

If you enjoy honest, data-driven, and critical looks at the Flight Simulator Marketplace without the fluff, make sure to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel, and clear skies on your next departure!
